title: very sturdy
text: very sturdy. These are the best stackable shelf units I have ever purchased.  I am using them as a shoe rack. They don't require any tools and are up in seconds.  I only purchased one set as I planned to use them for shoes in my closet.  However, I would not hesitate in ordering more of these whenever I need a reliable, sturdy stacking shelf unit.  They come in a flat box and were well shipped.  The barred shelf pieces "snap" onto the rectangle "leg" pieces and are remarkably strong.  If you are used to the flimsy, throw-away shoe racks of the old days, you will be most pleasantly surprised. Highly recommended.
